description: Header file defining classes and structures for an OSS proxy executor in the torch::aot_inductor namespace, including kernel classes, argument structures, and executor class with methods for serialization and execution.

classes.name: OSSDynamicArg
classes.description: Represents a dynamic argument with index, type, length, and optional list item types.

classes.name: OSSTorchBindArg
classes.description: Represents a Torch bind argument with index and name.

classes.name: OSSOpKernel
classes.description: Abstract base class for operation kernels, with target, arguments, outputs, and stack.

classes.name: OSSOpKernelOperator
classes.description: Kernel that wraps a c10::OperatorHandle to execute an operator.

classes.name: OSSCallTorchBindKernel
classes.description: Kernel that wraps a torch::jit::Function to execute a Torch bind method.

classes.name: OSSProxyExecutor
classes.description: Executor class for proxying function calls, managing kernels, serialization, and execution.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the integer representation of a DynamicArgType.

methods.name: num_output_tensors
methods.description: Returns the number of output tensors based on output argument types and lengths.

methods.name: num_output_ints
methods.description: Returns the number of output integers based on output argument types and lengths.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Pure virtual method to run the kernel with a given stack.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get the function schema.

methods.name: OSSProxyExecutor
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the proxy executor with JSON path, CPU flag, and optional custom objects.

methods.name: call_function
methods.description: Method to invoke a function with serialized arguments and tensors.

methods.name: prefill_stack_with_static_arguments
methods.description: Pre-fills the execution stack with static arguments based on schema and serialized data.

methods.name: get_input_info_from_serialized
methods.description: Extracts input argument info from serialized JSON and schema.

methods.name: get_output_info_from_serialized
methods.description: Extracts output argument info from serialized JSON and schema.

methods.name: get_call_torch_bind_kernel
methods.description: Creates a call kernel for Torch bind functions from serialized JSON.
